title: Conversational Anchor Sentinel & Rollback Orchestration for Cost Tuning
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background: We're ramping up automated batching/caching recommendations to reduce per-token cost. Past work reduced cost but introduced subtle conversational regressions in low-frequency intents. We need a lightweight, production-safe evaluation and orchestration layer that ties cost-driven config changes to conversational-quality checks and automated staged rollback when regressions are detected.

Goal: Build a "conversational anchor sentinel" — a compact eval harness using curated short dialogs (anchors) and behavioral probes that run during canary/rollout windows. The sentinel produces a semantic-consistency score and a risk tier; integrates with the rollout controller to pause or rollback config changes when thresholds are breached. Must be latency-aware (respect batching/caching SLOs) and operate cheaply as part of an automated apply.

Acceptance criteria:
- A canonical anchor corpus of ~250 contextual dialogs covering core intents, edge cases, and regulatory phrasing is stored and versioned (Drive/Confluence link below).
- A deterministic scoring pipeline that combines: (1) cosine drift of response embeddings vs baseline, (2) token-level normalized edit distance to reference/golden responses, and (3) a lightweight semantic-stability metric (delta-entropy of next-token distribution). Scores are normalized to a 0-100 scale.
- Thresholds defined for three risk tiers (green/yellow/red) with clear mapping to rollout actions: continue, hold+human-review, immediate rollback.
- Canary orchestration hooks implemented in the rollout controller: shadow eval -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> full with sentinel evaluation windows after each step.
- Automated rollback initiated if any anchor falls into red OR if cohort-level semantic score drops more than X points AND human audit flag triggered for ambiguous cases.
- Dashboard tile in Console showing anchor-level deltas, per-route impact, and latency/cost tradeoff; metrics recorded in telemetry (Prometheus + traces).

Plan / Implementation notes:
1) Anchor corpus: curate 250 anchors from production logs + product team selections. Each anchor contains: user prompt context (history up to 3 turns), expected intent label, 1-3 golden responses (short canonical variants), and acceptance tolerance band. Store in a versioned CSV and a JSONL artifact for eval harness.
2) Scoring pipeline: implement as a standalone microservice (serverless or small k8s job) that accepts a config diff (batch/cache profile) and runs anchors in shadow mode. Compute embedding drift (use embeddings model id pinned in release), normalized edit-distance, and delta-entropy. Combine using weighted formula (weights tunable via Console).
3) Statistical tests: use bootstrap sampling across anchors to estimate confidence intervals for deltas; require p<0.05 for auto-rollback decisions when deltas are marginal. Full rules in design doc.
4) Rollout orchestration: integrate sentinel as a pre-step to each rollout phase. If sentinel returns yellow, open a human review ticket with sampled anchors + diffs; if red, trigger automated rollback and create incident notes.
5) Telemetry & audit: record per-anchor scores, seed model/quantization flags, and batch/cache config snapshot. Expose anchor diffs in Console with links to sample responses and side-by-side comparison.

Trade-offs & rationale:
- Compact anchor set keeps cost low during canaries but may miss rare regressions; mitigated by stratified sampling from production tails and periodic larger batch audits.
- Combining three metrics reduces false positives vs single-metric rules but increases tuning complexity; we will start with conservative thresholds and expand after 2 sprints of live data.
- Keep automated rollback conservative (favor human review) for high-customer-impact routes; allow aggressive auto-apply for low-impact internal endpoints.

- Design doc (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Conversational+Anchor+Sentinel
- Anchor corpus (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folderid-anchor-corpus
- Eval harness prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123
- Rollout controller changes PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/1287

Next steps / immediate tasks:
- [A] Finalize anchor list with PM and Solutions Eng (owner: Miguel) by 2026-03-10.
- [B] Ship scoring microservice prototype and run shadow experiments against runtime-1.20 by 2026-03-18. (owner: eng-batching team)
- [C] Wire sentinel outputs to rollout controller and add human-review gate UI by 2026-03-25.
- [D] Run 2-week pilot on low-risk internal routes, evaluate false positive/negative rates, adjust thresholds.

Notes: This ticket intentionally scopes the sentinel for conversational/text generation routes first (chat and completions). Embeddings and reranking routes will be covered in a follow-up ticket after initial pilot.
